env_allowlist.HOME: runner account used only to locate the already installed pinned Lean toolchain

network_enforcement: The checker performs only local reconciliation and invokes the pinned Lean binary directly against existing read-only dependency outputs. It makes no network request and performs no Lake resolution, update, build, clone, fetch, checkout, or .lake mutation.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact deterministic seven-line negative release summary

scope_boundary: This bounded worker recipe binds current structured authority, prior provisional receipts, and a current trust-zero warm-cache Lean replay. It cannot master-accept the validation dependency, reconcile provisional proof evidence into authoritative graph state, supply H0/R0 or complete trust/provenance/SBOM evidence, perform a clean empty-cache cold offline build, act as an independent verifier, or grant release acceptance.
